description: Create a one-time crypto payment link with ZERO setup, no account, no API key. Give a destination wallet address and an amount; get back a shareable pay_url, an embeddable button, and a manage_url. Non-custodial: funds settle directly to the address you provide. Optionally pass an email so the owner can claim a full dashboard later.

address.description: Destination wallet; funds settle here. Shieldz never holds them.

email.description: Optional, lets the owner claim a dashboard later

name: create_payment_link
